posts.title: Celebrate small wins
posts.description: In this fast paced world, it is important to celebrate small wins. Instead of immediately chasing the next idea or next goal, take the time to celebrate.

posts.title: You should use AI for Coding
posts.description: If you are someone who is skeptical or has thought about using AI but takes pride in writing code line by line, this post is for you. But I'm not going to try to convince you either. I'm going to try to make you consider using AI for coding.

posts.title: Thoughts on gstack
posts.description: gstack sits in the tension between being overhyped and oversimplified, between "best thing since sliced bread" and "it's just a bunch of markdown files".
